Many people like to eat breakfast at home. Some people only drink coffee. Others cook a big meal with eggs and rice.

The words we use for meals tell us about food. A restaurant menu can have many dishes. Each dish has a price.

Cooking at home costs less money. It also lets a family eat together every day.

I’m Ana Lopez.

Ana Lopez wrote this story for VOA Learning English.

Words in This Story

dish -n. food prepared in a particular way
